raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.3.25"
  maturin_min: "1"
  maturin_max: "2"
  python_check_max: "3.14"
  cargo_wrapper: cargo-auditable-wrapper.${{ "sh" if unix else "bat" }}
  # mangle (lib)(ssl|crypto).lib for ladybugdb to avoid:
  #  LINK : fatal error LNK1181: cannot open input file 'ssl.lib'
  mangle_win_libopenssl: |-
    copy "%LIBRARY_LIB%\libssl.lib" "%LIBRARY_LIB%\ssl.lib" && copy "%LIBRARY_LIB%\libcrypto.lib" "%LIBRARY_LIB%\crypto.lib"
  unmangle_win_libopenssl: |-
    del "%LIBRARY_LIB%\ssl.lib" "%LIBRARY_LIB%\crypto.lib"
  # posix-ish stuff
  grep_version: ${{ "grep -iE " if unix else "findstr /r /c:" }}${{ version | replace('.', '\\.') }}
  # pytest args
  pytest_k: |-
    not pg_db_load_and_query

recipe:
  name: rudof-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/rudof-project/rudof/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f85dbde19c3d902d685ed0a5f933e1a02a712ee3ccc099a933d2e2efd88a9284

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: rudof
    build:
      skip: kind != "cli" or ("python_rc" in channel_sources)
      files:
        exclude:
          - "**/rudof-completions"
          - "**/rudof-completions.exe"
      script:
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
          OPENSSL_DIR: ${{ '$PREFIX' if unix else '%LIBRARY_PREFIX%' }}
        content:
          - if: win
            then: ${{ mangle_win_libopenssl }}
          - cd rudof_cli
          - cargo install --no-track --locked --path=. --profile=release "--root=${{ '${PREFIX}' if unix else '%LIBRARY_PREFIX%' }}"
          - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
          - if: win
            then: ${{ unmangle_win_libopenssl }}
          - if: build_platform == target_platform
            then:
              - if: unix
                then:
                  - mkdir -p "${PREFIX}/share/bash-completion/completions" "${PREFIX}/share/elvish/lib" "${PREFIX}/share/fish/vendor_completions.d" "${PREFIX}/share/powershell/completions" "${PREFIX}/share/zsh/site-functions"
                  - rudof-completions bash       > "${PREFIX}/share/bash-completion/completions/rudof"
                  - rudof-completions elvish     > "${PREFIX}/share/elvish/lib/rudof.elv"
                  - rudof-completions fish       > "${PREFIX}/share/fish/vendor_completions.d/rudof.fish"
                  - rudof-completions powershell > "${PREFIX}/share/powershell/completions/rudof.ps1"
                  - rudof-completions zsh        > "${PREFIX}/share/zsh/site-functions/_rudof"
                else:
                  - md "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\bash-completion\completions" "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\elvish\lib" "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\fish\vendor_completions.d" "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\powershell\completions" "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\zsh\site-functions"
                  - rudof-completions bash       > "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\bash-completion\completions\rudof"
                  - rudof-completions elvish     > "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\elvish\lib\rudof.elv"
                  - rudof-completions fish       > "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\fish\vendor_completions.d\rudof.fish"
                  - rudof-completions powershell > "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\powershell\completions\rudof.ps1"
                  - rudof-completions zsh        > "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\zsh\site-functions\_rudof"

    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        # fails with:
        #   thread 'main' (12097) panicked at cargo-auditable/src/collect_audit_data.rs:96:9:
        #   cargo metadata failure: error: cannot update the lock file $SRC_DIR/Cargo.lock because --locked was passed to prevent this
        #   help: to generate the lock file without accessing the network, remove the --locked flag and use --offline instead.
        # - cargo-auditable
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - cmake
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - if: win
          then:
            - perl
      host:
        - openssl
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          bin:
            - rudof
          files:
            - ${{ 'Library/' if win }}share/bash-completion/completions/rudof
            - ${{ 'Library/' if win }}share/elvish/lib/rudof.elv
            - ${{ 'Library/' if win }}share/fish/vendor_completions.d/rudof.fish
            - ${{ 'Library/' if win }}share/powershell/completions/rudof.ps1
            - ${{ 'Library/' if win }}share/zsh/site-functions/_rudof
      - script:
          - rudof --help
          - rudof --version
          - rudof --version | ${{ grep_version }}
    about:
      homepage: https://crates.io/crates/rudof_cli
      repository: https://github.com/rudof-project/rudof/tree/master/rudof_cli
      description: >
        rudof is a command-line tool to inspect and validate RDF data using ShEx
        or SHACL, and to allow conversion between different RDF data modeling
        languages like ShEx, SHACL, DCTAP, etc.
      license_file:
        - LICENSE-APACHE
        - LICENSE-MIT
        - rudof_cli/THIRDPARTY.yml

  - package:
      name: pyrudof
    build:
      skip: kind not in ["py", "abi3"] or (is_abi3 and not is_python_min)
      python:
        version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
      script:
        env:
          CARGO: ${{ cargo_wrapper }}
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
          OPENSSL_DIR: ${{ '$PREFIX' if unix else '%LIBRARY_PREFIX%' }}
          PYO3_PYTHON: ${{ '$PYTHON' if unix else '%PYTHON%' }}
        content:
          - if: win
            then:
              - ${{ mangle_win_libopenssl }}
              - set CARGO_HOME=c:\.cg
              - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\${{ cargo_wrapper }}" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\"
            else:
              - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/${{ cargo_wrapper }}" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/"
              - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/${{ cargo_wrapper }}"
          - cd bindings/python
          - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check --check-build-dependencies
          - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
          - if: win
            then: ${{ unmangle_win_libopenssl }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cargo-auditable
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - cmake
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - if: win
          then:
            - perl
      host:
        - maturin >=${{ maturin_min }},<${{ maturin_max }}
        - openssl
        - pip
        - python
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - python-abi3
      run:
        - python
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          files:
            - etc/conda/test-files/pyrudof/**
          site_packages:
            - pyrudof/**
            - pyrudof-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
      - python:
          imports: pyrudof
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - if: is_abi3
              then:
                - ${{ python_min }}.*
                - ${{ python_check_max }}.*
              else:
                - "*"
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pytest
            - if: is_abi3
              then:
                - abi3audit
                - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        files:
          source:
            - bindings/python/examples/
            - bindings/python/pyproject.toml
            - bindings/python/tests/
            - examples/
            - rudof_lib/src/default_config.toml
        script:
          - python -c "print(__import__('pyrudof').__version__)" | ${{ grep_version }}
          - cd bindings/python
          - pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes -k "${{ pytest_k }}"
          - if: is_abi3
            then:
              - cd "${{ "${SP_DIR}" if unix else "%SP_DIR%" }}/pyrudof"
              - abi3audit -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }} _pyrudof.${{ "pyd" if win else "abi3.so" }}
    about:
      homepage: https://pypi.org/project/pyrudof
      repository: https://github.com/rudof-project/rudof/tree/master/bindings/python
      summary: Python bindings for Rudof, RDF data shapes implementation in Rust
      license_file:
        - LICENSE-APACHE
        - LICENSE-MIT
        - bindings/python/THIRDPARTY.yml

about:
  license: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE-APACHE
    - LICENSE-MIT
  summary: RDF data shapes implementation in Rust
  homepage: https://github.com/rudof-project/rudof
  repository: https://github.com/rudof-project/rudof

extra:
  feedstock-name: rudof
  recipe-maintainers:
